components.name: Refill Record Form
components.purpose: Allows users to log refill events with fields for machine ID, date, items added, and quantity

components.name: Refill Record List
components.purpose: Displays refill history with search and filter capabilities by machine or date range

components.name: Login Page
components.purpose: Provides authentication interface for staff users to access the application

components.name: Authentication Service
components.purpose: Handles user login, session management, and role-based access control for staff members

components.name: Vending Machine API
components.purpose: Manages CRUD operations for vending machine records with endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting machines

components.name: Refill Record API
components.purpose: Manages CRUD operations for refill records with endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting refill events

components.name: Reporting Service
components.purpose: Generates reports on refill frequency, inventory levels, and machine performance metrics

components.name: Machines Table
components.purpose: Stores vending machine information including machine ID, location, capacity, and status

components.name: Refill Records Table
components.purpose: Stores refill event data including machine ID, date, items added, quantity, and staff member

components.name: Users Table
components.purpose: Stores staff user credentials, roles, and permissions for system access

components.name: Role-Based Access Control
components.purpose: Ensures only authorized staff can view and modify refill records and machine data

components.name: User Authentication
components.purpose: Protects system access through secure login and session management

components.name: Data Validation
components.purpose: Validates all input data to prevent injection attacks and maintain data integrity

constraints.rawText: Staff users must have access to the vending machine refill tracker application
